products.note: HR and finance AI; skills-based talent; predictive analytics; sensitive HR data exposure

profile_text.body:
Workday is a public company, traded as WDAY, founded in 2005 and headquartered in Pleasanton, California. Its own site describes it as an enterprise AI platform for HR, finance, and IT, and promotes Sana and agentic AI from Workday. The company says its AI lets customers activate teams of specialized agents to perform key processes across HR, finance, and IT, and that those agents can find, build, act, and automate rather than only assist. It also says the platform is meant to turn AI into ROI faster, with outcomes it attributes to trust, agility, and data readiness.

The product tracked for Workday is Workday AI, described as HR and finance AI covering skills-based talent, predictive analytics, and sensitive HR data exposure. Company filings list CIK 0001327811, and a 10-K for the period ending 2026-01-31 reports revenue of 9552000000 US dollars.

On litigation, the record lists nine cases naming Workday, Inc. as defendant, spread across the District Court for the Eastern District of California, the Northern District of Georgia, the Northern District of California, the District of Colorado, the District of Maryland, and the Eastern District of Virginia. Several share the same case name, including Meckfessel Poletti v. Workday, Inc. and Hill v. Workday, Inc. California is the state with the largest recorded law exposure for the company, at 281.
